"""Fixed deletion and norm-matched controls of the current publication."""
import gc
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import torch

from cfg import load_config
from _impl.attacks import author_recover, load_author
from _impl.evaluate import run, verify
from _impl.io import digest, save_json
from _impl.metrics import logical_parameter_distance
from _impl.models import apply, initialize, load_checkpoint

definition = load_config('results/data_free_compensation/finite_components_protocol.json')
root = Path(definition['output'])
cfg = json.loads(Path(definition['reference_protocol']).read_text())
cfg.update(output=str(root / 'evaluation'), experiment=definition['purpose'],
           mergers=['TA'], attack_scopes=['None', 'Protected expert', 'All experts'],
           cases=[], legacy={}, source_sha256=definition['source_sha256'])
cfg.pop('DARE', None)
cfg.pop('TIES', None)
initialize()
start = time.perf_counter()
base = load_checkpoint('zeroshot.pt')
author, author_sha = load_author('external/secure-merge-attack/' + cfg['AGA']['file'], True)
assert author_sha == cfg['AGA']['sha256']
frozen = []
for target in definition['tasks']:
    expert = load_checkpoint(target + '/finetuned.pt')
    original = expert.state_dict()
    reference = apply(expert, cfg['AGA_references'][target], full=True).state_dict()
    main = cfg['defenses']['Defense2_' + target]
    assert digest(main['release']['path']) == main['release']['sha256']
    edits = torch.load(main['release']['path'], map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
    assert len(edits) == 4 and all('.resblocks.11.mlp.' in k for k in edits)
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(definition['seed'])
    noise, norms = {}, {}
    for key in sorted(edits):
        delta = edits[key].double() - original[key].double()
        draw = torch.randn(delta.shape, dtype=torch.float64, generator=generator)
        noise[key] = (original[key].double() + draw * (delta.norm() / draw.norm())).float()
        actual = float((noise[key].double() - original[key].double()).norm())
        norms[key] = dict(main=float(delta.norm()), random=actual)
        assert abs(actual - float(delta.norm())) <= 1e-5 * max(1., float(delta.norm()))
    controls = {'A_only': {k: v for k, v in edits.items() if '.c_fc.' in k},
                'B+b_only': {k: v for k, v in edits.items() if '.c_proj.' in k},
                'Random_noise': noise}
    names = ['Defense2_' + target]
    for name, values in controls.items():
        folder = root / 'publications' / target / name
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        torch.save(values, folder / 'release.pt')
        release = dict(path=str(folder / 'release.pt'), sha256=digest(folder / 'release.pt'))
        model = apply(expert, release)
        before = time.perf_counter()
        restored = author_recover(model, base, author).state_dict()
        aga = {k: v for k, v in restored.items() if not torch.equal(v, reference[k])}
        torch.save(aga, folder / 'AGA_edits.pt')
        label = name + '_' + target
        names.append(label)
        cfg['defenses'][label] = dict(target=target, release=release,
            AGA_edits=dict(path=str(folder / 'AGA_edits.pt'), sha256=digest(folder / 'AGA_edits.pt')))
        frozen.append(dict(control=name, logical_distance=logical_parameter_distance(values, original),
            tensors=list(values), norm_comparison=norms if name == 'Random_noise' else None,
            AGA_seconds=time.perf_counter()-before, **cfg['defenses'][label]))
        del model, restored, aga
        gc.collect()
    partner = 'SVHN' if target == 'MNIST' else 'MNIST'
    cfg['cases'].append(dict(target=target, partner=partner, defenses=names))
    reuse = definition['reuse'][target]
    assert digest(reuse['path']) == reuse['sha256']
    metadata = json.loads(Path(reuse['execution']).read_text())
    for name, oldname in [('Unprotected', 'Unprotected'),
                           ('Defense2_' + target, 'FiniteClassification_' + target)]:
        cfg['legacy'][target + '_' + partner + '/' + name] = {
            stage: dict(path=reuse['path'], sha256=reuse['sha256'],
                key_template=oldname + '/' + key + '/{task}',
                model_parameter_sha256=metadata['evaluated_parameter_sha256'][oldname + '/' + key])
            for stage, key in [('standalone', 'Standalone/None'), ('direct', 'TA/None'),
                               ('AGA_target_only', 'TA/Protected expert'), ('AGA_both', 'TA/All experts')]}
    del expert, original, reference, edits, controls, noise
    gc.collect()
del base
gc.collect()
save_json(root / 'construction.json', dict(controls=frozen, seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,
    real_construction_images=0, expert_updates=0, new_full_AGA_calls=len(frozen),
    source_sha256=digest(__file__), protocol_sha256=digest('results/data_free_compensation/finite_components_protocol.json')))
prepared = root / 'evaluation.json'
save_json(prepared, cfg)
print('ALL_NINE_CONTROLS_FROZEN', flush=True)
for i, case in enumerate(cfg['cases']):
    for pilot in [True, False]:
        run(prepared, i, pilot)
        directory = root / 'evaluation' / ('pilot' if pilot else 'full') / f"{i:02d}_{case['target']}_{case['partner']}"
        verify(directory)
save_json(root / 'completed.json', dict(status='full_evaluation_and_context_replay_complete',
    new_controls=9, full_rows=105, reused_full_rows=42, independent_summary_pending=True))
print('FINITE_COMPONENTS_FINISHED', flush=True)
